item.title: US 35 EB reopens near Woodman Drive after crash
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) -- A crash closed all eastbound lanes of U.S. 35 are closed in a part of Montgomery County Sunday afternoon. According to OHGO, a crash occurred on U.S. 35 eastbound near Woodman Drive. Police had all lanes of the highway blocked. All lanes have since reopened.

item.description: Ilia Malinin beat Japanese rival Shun Sato in a head-to-head showdown at the Milan Cortina Olympics on Sunday night, helping the U.S. defend its team figure skating gold medal.
